# Read the project history without guessing

Use this utility to inspect the committed audit and change log: recent work, decisions, searches, exact past prompts and the local timeline viewer.

## When to use it

Use `auditlog` at the start of work to learn what happened before, when you need to recall a decision, or when you want to reuse a past prompt exactly.

## What you need

The repository needs `docs/audit/` from prior skill runs or explicit logging. If it does not exist, the honest answer is that no committed history is available yet.

## Try it

Slash-command harnesses:

```text
/auditlog search export authorization
```

Codex equivalent:

```text
$auditlog search export authorization
```

Direct script shape when needed:

```text
python docs/ai-forward-pack/scripts/audit-log.py list --n 10
```

Use `python` or `py -3` on Windows if `python3` is not present.

## What happens

The skill maps your request to the audit script: list, search, get an exact prompt, show the change timeline, render the viewer, or suggest decisions not yet logged.

## What you get

Illustrative output shape:

```text
id       datetime           kind     summary
al-1042 2026-09-20 10:15   skill    specified CSV export fields
al-1048 2026-09-20 11:02   change   chose all matching rows, not visible page
```

## Review before continuing

For a redo, insist on the exact prompt text, not a paraphrase. For decisions, check whether the change log entry is the meaningful record or only an audit action.

## Tips and recovery

If the log is absent, do not reconstruct history from memory. If a search is too broad, narrow by keyword, session or date.

## Where to go next

Use [prompts](#skill-prompts) or [searchprompts](#skill-searchprompts) for fast prompt reuse, or the relevant workflow for the recalled task.
